ac2_bound.statement: Resident evidence state is O(page) not O(rows): page = SEARCH_EVIDENCE_STREAM_PAGE_SIZE (200 knowledge objects), plus one batch (SEARCH_INDEX_REFRESH_BATCH_SIZE 16) and one embedding chunk (4). Startup/reload/refresh read nothing. Point reads use the unique (record_type, record_id) index or the object-id expression index owned by source-ingest.
